questiontext.text: Which best describes the core mechanism of heap sort?

answer.text: Build a max-heap, then repeatedly swap the root to the end and sift the new root down over the shrinking heap

feedback.text: Correct — build once, then extract-max n times via sift-down.

generalfeedback.text: Heap sort turns the array into a binary max-heap, then repeatedly moves the maximum (the root) to the end and restores the heap with sift-down.
